Let’s be clear. The lives of countless women across the country will be at risk because they can no longer exercise a constitutional right they’ve had for decades to decide what happens to their own body. 
 
It's archaic and wrong. We can’t give up this fight.

Thanks to the Biden Administration and @US_FDA—Americans will soon be able to get safe and affordable hearing aids over-the-counter. This will significantly lower the costs and increase access for Michiganders experiencing hearing loss. https://t.co/KWeKMWbJAQ

Michigan’s top-notch defense capabilities showcase the best of our state. 

Today I observed cold-weather trainings at Camp Grayling during Exercise Northern Strike –– a premier @USNationalGuard exercise that underscores Michigan's importance to our national security. https://t.co/Uxo6Q1JgO3

I joined Lieutenant General Sasseville & Major General Rogers at Camp Grayling for the National Guard's premier cold-weather trainings as part of Exercise Northern Strike. 

Proud that the National Guard & our state play such an important role in our national security. https://t.co/DBX9WmLdY4

While this ruling is a win for democracy, the fight to protect voting rights is far from over.

I’ll continue standing up against attacks to this sacred right and supporting efforts to ensure Americans can exercise their constitutional right to vote.
https://t.co/HVS0RFKLQw

It's tragic that hundreds of thousands of young people suffering from opioid addiction struggle to get the care they need. 

My bipartisan bill would expand lifesaving addiction treatments for adolescents to help set them on a path toward recovery.
https://t.co/FtmrwP1PYm

Medicare open enrollment ENDS on December 7!

To learn more and #GetCovered visit:
https://t.co/WRKCwju5AW

TOMORROW is the deadline for Medicare open enrollment. 

To learn more and #GetCovered click below! 
https://t.co/WRKCwju5AW

NEWS: the SUPPORT Act just passed through @HELPCmteDems — and it includes my bipartisan effort to expand opioid addiction treatment for teens!

Young people must be able to access lifesaving treatment as we take on the opioid crisis.

Read more ⬇️⬇️⬇️ 
https://t.co/qgBD2XBRMs

Last year, Michigan native Shandra Eisenga passed away after contracting tuberculosis from an infected bone graft she received.

My bill would help protect patients and ensure that tragedies like that never happen again.
https://t.co/xYQs20yQW9

Negotiating prescription drug prices against Medicare will ensure that fewer Americans have to choose between putting food on the table and getting the medicine they need.

The Inflation Reduction Act is making that happen — that’s why I voted for it.
https://t.co/cHjS3Y3q9u

Everyone deserves access to quality, affordable health care.

I'm proud that the Inflation Reduction Act — which I helped pass — has cut health care premiums for more than 270,000 Michiganders across our state.

I was proud to cosponsor a bill that would protect the right to seek IVF treatment. That's as pro-family as it gets — but yesterday Republicans refused to even put it on the floor.

Every American who wants to be a parent should have that opportunity. https://t.co/OZAjQAPnu5

My program to expand opioid addiction treatment for teens was included in the SUPPORT Act that @HELPCmteDems recently passed.
 
I was honored to stand with folks impacted by the opioid crisis in Genesee Countyand share how that program would help young people who need it most. https://t.co/1v9yMDq2Mw

I helped create the Youth Prevention and Recovery Initiative to provide access to treatment options for teens suffering from opioid addiction.

My bipartisan provision in the SUPPORT Act would protect that program, and ensure that young Michiganders get the help they need. https://t.co/z4Yn4ab6h9

Northern Strike is a premier @USNationalGuard training exercise. It showcases the best of Michigan's defense capabilities.

That's why I pushed to secure continued funding for it in the funding bill Congress recently passed into law.
https://t.co/SMwOSUYtL7

Private equity groups may be putting profits over patients in the emergency rooms that they run.

As Chair of @HSGAC, I’m pushing them for answers.
https://t.co/hIllbnpW4a

I stand with the health care professionals going on strike at MyMichigan Health in Sault Ste. Marie and Ascension St. John.
 
This strike isn't just about workers getting the wages and working conditions they deserve — it's about making sure that patients get the care they need. https://t.co/lstjNSPyU4

I’m proud to cosponsor a resolution celebrating this week as National Nurses Week! 

My mother was a nurses aide, and I’m so grateful to ALL the hardworking nurses who devote their lives to the wellbeing of their patients.

Buying a home, especially nowadays, can be a confusing, expensive process. So, I've introduced bipartisan legislation that would both help teach new homebuyers the skills they need and give them a leg up on their FHA mortgage insurance premiums.
https://t.co/nSZV9wgnyz

Rural hospitals are irreplaceable to their communities but many — like Ontonogan Hospital in the Upper Peninsula — are closing down.

My bill would cut operating costs for rural hospitals to help them stay open and continue providing life-saving care.
https://t.co/ZflkojWA1N

The findings of this report are absolutely unacceptable.

I pushed for this investigation after learning of the death of Ian Fishback, and I'll push to put changes in place to ensure all veterans can trust that they will receive world-class care.
https://t.co/uxKtTkhpW2

Northern Strike is one of our country’s premier joint training exercises. And it’s made possible by Michigan’s unique training capabilities. 

It was a pleasure getting a bird’s eye view of this year’s summer iteration of the exercise. #ZooToTheSoo https://t.co/ykbMV28VJR

Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act that I helped pass, Medicare can now negotiate lower prescription drug prices! 

These first 10 drugs will help make critical medication for cancer, diabetes, and heart failure more affordable for about 9 million seniors.

President Biden’s decision to pardon his son was wrong. A president's family and allies shouldn't get special treatment. This was an improper use of power, it erodes trust in our government, and it emboldens others to bend justice to suit their interests.
